action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2-4 and full single-candidate verification both show d3d4 is commit-ready: exact score 73, no mate-in-one against it (safety complete), and the tactical-refutation probe over checking replies (Qxf2+) found no forced mate. Opponent's actual reply g6h6 pulled the rook off g6, so the bishop on h5 is less attacked. d4 advances the center, opens the d-file for Qd1, and forces the f8-bishop to move. Commit the verified move.
action.objective: Advance the d-pawn to d4, grabbing central space and opening the queen's line.
